productBugs.summary: On a Knowledge Item the Documents Type column renders an editable select (No type plus the item's Knowledge type), but every choice is refused. DOC-015's Knowledge addendum says the label is derived from the item, so the cell should be read-only.
productBugs.reproduction: As administrator, create a Knowledge Item, upload a file in its Documents section, then choose No type in "Type of version 1 of <title>". Observed: the section shows "That version already has this type." and the Version keeps "Template". Choosing the Knowledge type itself is a no-op in the browser; the same id sent to PATCH /documents/:id/versions/:versionId answers 400 "Pick a document type from this record's list.".
productBugs.source: apps/web/src/components/documents/documents-card.tsx TypeCell (options include the derived Knowledge type, so readOnly is false)

steps.action: Before you start: open the profile menu, select Settings, then Documents; read the three type lists
steps.expected: Documents shows Matters, Contracts and Entities tabs; the Contract list starts with the seven fixed types, Partially signed among them
steps.actual: Profile menu (Daniel Okafor) -> Settings -> Documents opened /settings/documents/matters with tabs Matters, Contracts, Entities. The Contracts tab listed Draft · ours, Draft · theirs, Redline · theirs, Redline · ours, Partially signed, Executed, Amendment (7 fixed-row lock labels) plus types other agents added. The Entities tab held 0 active types at this moment (read-back).

steps.action: Before you start and the Type column: with the Entity list empty, an Entity upload has no Type and the column shows a dash with no choice
steps.expected: No Type control in Upload document; the new Version's Type cell reads a dash and offers no select
steps.actual: Entity "DOC-032 documents V-C26 empty-list Entity 09280710 Ltd": Upload document showed Choose files and Note but no Type (count 0). After Upload the row "doc029-bulk-a.txt" v1 had cells ["doc029-bulk-a.txt","—","v1","Sep 28","Uploaded by Daniel Okafor DO",""]; the Type cell read "—" with no select (0 "Type of version 1" controls).

steps.action: Configure Document type colours: Settings, Documents, Contracts, select the colour swatch beside the run's Contract type; choose Purple, then Automatic, then Purple again
steps.expected: The swatch offers Automatic and seven colours; each choice saves at once without a Save button; Automatic restores the default

Choosing Purple closed it and saved at once (read-back color purple; swatch title "Colour for DOC-032 documents V-C26 Contract type 09280710: Purple"). Automatic saved null (swatch title "Colour for DOC-032 documents V-C26 Contract type 09280710: Automatic"). Purple again read back purple (swatch title "Colour for DOC-032 documents V-C26 Contract type 09280710: Purple").

steps.action: Configure Document type colours: a fixed Contract type keeps its name but takes a colour (Partially signed, changed and put back at once)
steps.expected: The fixed row has no rename control and says its colour can be changed; a colour choice saves; the name stays; the prior colour is restored
steps.actual: The fixed row "Partially signed" (systemKind partially_signed) had no "Rename Partially signed" control and carried "Partially signed has a fixed name. Its colour can be changed.". Its colour read back null (Automatic). Choosing Red saved at once (read-back color red, name still "Partially signed"; swatch title "Colour for Partially signed: Red"). Choosing Automatic put it back (read-back null) within the same step.

steps.actual: Two chosen files opened the "Import 2 files" dialog instead of the composer. Cancel closed it; the Contract still held one Document.

steps.action: Upload step 4: Actions, Edit details, Save changes the name and description

steps.action: Add another Version steps 1-3: Actions, Add version, Choose file, Type (starts on No type), Note, Upload; the arrow beside the name shows earlier Versions; read v1
steps.expected: Version number rises to v2 without copying v1's type; the arrow sits after the name; v1 opens in the reader and downloads its original bytes

steps.action: Before you start and the Type column: an archived Document or owning record freezes the Type column; an archived record hides Upload and refuses uploads until restored
steps.expected: No Type select while archived; Upload hidden; a direct upload is refused with a restore message; after restore the controls return
steps.actual: C-46: live, v1's Type was a select. With the Document archived (Show archived on) its Type cell was a plain label (["doc029-bulk-a.txt Primary Archived","Draft · ours","v1","Sep 28","Uploaded by Daniel Okafor DO",""]), no select. With the Contract archived the section had no Upload button and no Type select; a direct upload answered 409 ("This contract is archived. Restore it before uploading.") and a direct type correction answered 409. After restore, Upload and the Type select returned; the chain still had one Version typed Draft · ours.

steps.action: Recover from a refusal: a failed upload shows its message and does not alter the chain

steps.actual: With a browser-network fixture answering 413 for the Version upload, Add version stayed open with "DOC-032 fixture: this file is larger than the upload limit.". The chain still had 4 Versions with identical ids, numbers, types, notes and pin.

steps.action: Delete version, current Version: set the Executed pin on v2 and prepare a Comparison of v2 to v3; then the Document's Actions menu, Delete version, the dialog names v3, type delete in Type "delete" to confirm, Delete version
steps.expected: Delete version is disabled until delete is typed; v3, its stored file and the Comparison that names it are removed; v1 and v2 stay; the pin stays on v2
steps.actual: Fixture "doc032-delete-chain-09280710.docx" had v1-v3; "Actions for version 2" -> Mark as executed copy set the pin on v2, and a Comparison of v2 to v3 was prepared (API). The row's Actions menu offered Compare with previous, Make primary, Mark as executed copy, Add version, Edit details, Move to folder, Mark confidential, Archive, Delete version. Delete version opened "Delete version 3?" reading "Delete version 3? Version 3 of doc032-delete-chain-09280710.docx and its stored file will be removed. You cannot undo this. All other versions will remain. Type "delete" to confirm Cancel Delete version". The Delete version button (accessible name "Delete version 3 of doc032-delete-chain-09280710.docx") was disabled at open and with "remove" typed, enabled with "delete". After it, the row read v2; read-back Versions v1, v2 with v1 and v2 unchanged and the pin still on v2. The deleted Version's download answered 404. The Comparison of v2 to v3 answered 200 before and 404 after.

steps.action: Delete version: the number is not reused (Add version after the delete)
steps.expected: The next upload is v4, not v3
steps.actual: Add version -> Choose file -> Upload made v4; the row read v4 and read-back numbers were v1, v2, v4. v3 was not reused.

steps.action: Delete version, earlier Version: prepare a Comparison of v2 to v4; show earlier Versions, Actions for version 2 (the pinned Version), Delete version, type delete, Delete version
steps.expected: v2 is removed; the Executed pin is cleared; the Comparison that names v2 is removed; v1 and v4 stay
steps.actual: "Actions for version 2 of doc032-delete-chain-09280710.docx" offered Compare with previous, Unmark as executed copy, Delete version. Delete version opened "Delete version 2?"; after typing delete and Delete version, read-back Versions were v1, v4, none pinned (the pin on v2 was cleared). A Comparison of v2 to v4 prepared before the delete (API) answered 200 before and 404 after. v1 and v4 kept their ids, notes and files.

steps.action: Delete version, last Version: a one-Version Document's Actions, Delete version; the dialog says the Document will also be removed

Version 1 of doc032-delete-last-09280710.txt and its stored file will be removed. You cannot undo this. This is the last version, so the document will also be removed. Type "delete" ". After typing delete and Delete version the row left the list and read-back (including archived) no longer had the Document.
